finding_text: Parity test (test_us0120_closure_command_file_parity) asserts byte-identity only at pytest-run time. A developer editing .cursor/commands/closure.md without updating template/.cursor/commands/closure.md will cause silent drift between deliveries; no continuous guard (git hook or pre-commit) enforces ongoing byte-identity. Additionally, each /closure execution mandates an append to docs/engineering/state.md (per closure.md §Phase responsibility), yet enforce-triad-hot-surface.py already reports STATE_ARCHIVE_REQUIRED (exit 1, 1447/1000 lines). Every future /closure run amplifies this pre-existing hot-surface violation without triggering archival; the execute-phase acceptance of this as 'pre-existing' defers the accumulation without bounding it.

The /closure mutation ordering contract (backlog.md → acceptance.md → state.md → closure-verification.md per DEC-0040 §Artifact ordering) is enforced by prose in closure.md only. validate_closure_verification.py validates the closure-verification.md output schema but does not verify mutation sequencing; a conforming closure run that writes state.md before backlog.md passes all 10 contract tests undetected. Separately, test_us0120_auto_phase_plan_includes_closure (marker 6) accepts the OR fallback condition '`closure`' appearing anywhere in auto.md — it does not assert that closure is positioned BETWEEN release and refresh-context in the phase plan arrays, leaving the ordering invariant of DEC-0082's ship macro unverified by test.

CLOSURE_LEGACY_DRIFT reason code and its 3-signal drain-hook detection exist to handle in-flight stories at the US-0120 ship boundary; no sunset criterion is defined (e.g., 'retire once all pre-US-0120 release_queue rows with status=released are confirmed DONE'). This logic will persist as perpetual dead code after the transition backlog drains, creating ongoing maintenance surface. Additionally, test_us0120_backward_compat_drain_hook (marker 10) validates only that 'CLOSURE_LEGACY_DRIFT' and 'status=released' appear as substrings in closure.md — it does not execute the 3-signal detection logic or simulate a drain-hook scenario, so the actual backward-compat runtime behavior is untested beyond text presence.
